note: HELD: not to be rented until the owner double-clicks Rent-flashnext-tools.cmd. 22 Nov, the owner asked to run a big brain like Flash-Next in Bob on a rented card, to see how it does with the tools and whether they need adapting to a new tool shape. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL, 4 parts, 103.7 GiB) in Bob at 3fff3cf with the npc fixes (npc-fixes-on-3fff3cf0.patch): no step count at any Effort, no nudge cap, no thinking budget, no fixed reply size (do-jobs --max bob = the whole slot, as Bob), no per-job clock (--job-minutes 0); the rental hours and dollars caps are the outer net. Same jobs and scorers as stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: the 30 inbox catalog jobs at Minimus and Medius (mail-score; before = after2, steps40), the 36 office jobs (office-score), the 33 repository jobs at Minimus and Medius (repo-score; before = repo1), plus the repository jobs at Medius with thinking on every step (--think-every-step; the owner: "why are we limiting thinking at all?"). tool-faults.mjs counts calls by fault kind next to stock Qwen. Served on Brain Engine (llama.cpp b12359 + all 14 engine patches, from 3fff3cf) so that after every job and score, one phase maps the experts each kind of job uses (trace-read.mjs --runs, --parallel 1, 20 runs a kind, --mass) into out/expert-map. H200 (103.7 GiB does not fit a 96 GB RTX PRO 6000), 15 slots x 48K (12 full-attention layers x 2 KV heads: ~24 KiB a token, ~17 GiB for all slots). Caps 2.1 h / $11.

benchmark.note: one server: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; inbox, office and repository jobs at once, then the three scorers and the tool-fault count.

prep: HELD: the owner gives the go (double-click) before this is rented, and never while the owner's speed test runs on the PC.

Before = after2 (lab-kit-after2 out/after2-*-score), steps40 (lab-kit-steps out/steps40-*-score) and repo1 (lab-kit-repojobs out/repo1-score). Same jobs files and scorers. Limits differ on purpose: this copy has no step, nudge, thinking or reply-size limits, and the lab runs at --max bob.
The three job writers make their jobs on this PC (repo-jobs.mjs --check proves each repository job). The PC needs git, Node.js 20+ and lab-office's LibreOffice.
--want-shapes 4 stops the run before renting if this copy's tools are any other shape. Flash-Next is a Qwen brain to Bob (model-family.js), so it gets the Qwen tool set.

The expert-map phase runs last, alone (--parallel 1: Brain Engine gives the trace only to a request that ran alone), so it never slows or skews a score. Its pre-flight reads a made-up run for each runs file the jobs have not made yet.
fnt-tool-faults/TOOL-FAULTS.md is the key report; out/expert-map holds counts.json, lift.json, dials.json, keep/ and trace-read.md.
